notes: S1-FIX5 X5 (§11.5 rule 1, §5.3; decision 2026-11-12 #1): the previous manifest is signed by key X, and the only record of the target that lists X's public key is a rotation X->Y signed by Y alone, which is invalid (E_KEY_ROTATION_SIGS). An invalid rotation record supplies no key material, so X is not a required key of the target context: the link fails with E_MANIFEST_CHAIN, and since no equation was verified with context material there is no L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU (the target manifest itself is signed by the keyset root human-1).
